newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher to buy Norweb retail chain - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher to buy Norweb retail chain - paper.

text.p: British retailer Kingfisher is in talks to acquire the electrical retail operations of Norweb, the electricity company owned by United Utilities, for about 70 million stg, said the Sunday Telegraph newspaper.
The 70 out-of-town superstores and 60 shops were put up for sale at the beginning of the year as well as the group's power generation assets.

The retail chain has attracted interest from a range of trade buyers and venture capitalists but a trade sale to Kingfisher, which owns the 223-strong Comet retail chain, seems most likely, the article said.
Last year Norweb outlets made profits of about six million stg on turnover of 130 million.

Comet reduced losses in the half year to August 3 to three million stg from 8.7 million stg last time and analysts believe the division is continuing to benefit from a recovery in consumer confidence.
